text:
Predicates:
JapaneseGameCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
Sell(x, y) ::: x sells y copies.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Premises:
JapaneseGameCompany(company1) ∧ Created(company1, legendOfZelda) ∧ Game(legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ Top10(x) → JapaneseGameCompany(company_that_created_x)) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ Sell(x, million) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
Sell(legendOfZelda, million) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
